name: JUNE Medical USA INC
description: JUNE Medical USA Inc. is the Delaware-based US company of JUNE Medical, a privately owned medical device business with offices in the UK, the USA and Sweden. The group handles early-stage product concepts, research and development, manufacturing and commercialization, with its sister company Mosaic Surgical acting as the manufacturing arm. Products include the Galaxy II self-retaining surgical retractor, the HandMe retractor for hand surgery, the LUX Connect surgical light, Oxiplex adhesion barriers for intrauterine or peritoneal surgery, and the Thermablate EAS balloon system for heavy menstrual bleeding. Through local partners, JUNE Medical sells in more than 40 countries.
